text:
maya.k: Quick sync — ACME private rollout: final network sweep Friday 9:30 PT. Need owners for NAT egress, image sync, and image signing check.
samir: I can own NAT egress and firewall verification. Will run smoke tests after the change. @ben-oncall can you coordinate the test window?
ben-oncall: yep, 9:30-10:00 PT marked. I'll post the incident channel alert and add a paging schedule.
priya: Who has the airgap image bundle? Last I heard infra was preparing signed tarballs.
alex_r: Infra handed off signed images to me yesterday. I put them on the staging registry and validated checksums. See sha256: abc123def4567890... (truncated)
maya.k: can you paste the exact commands for curl and checksum? customer ops will run them.
alex_r: sure:
```bash
curl -fsSLO https://staging-reg.internal/edge/acme/bundle-v2.tar.gz
sha256sum bundle-v2.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'
# expected: abc123def4567890...
```
priya: note: customer infra needs a proxy for the curl (they're airgapped). We need to provide an http(s) proxy config sample and env var example.
samir: also confirm port 443 egress is allowed to the artifact mirror IPs. I'll add firewall rule snippet to the CR:
```yaml
- allow: outbound
  proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_ips: [198.51.100.23, 198.51.100.24]
```
maya.k: @alex_r can you open the small CR for the registry ACL change? need owner for rotation doc update too.
alex_r: opened CR: #4582, assigned to me. I'll add the rotation section and ping docs team.
ben-oncall: reminder: run the egress prober after 9:35 — I'll trigger prober and share results in this thread.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: private-deploy-acme — preflight started, status: all checks pending -> will update.
maya.k: thanks. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a screenshot + curl logs. I'll triage. :thumbsup: 
samir: quick Q — do we want to enable prefix caching on LBs now or after cutover? it affects warmup.
maya.k: enable after cutover; we don't want cached stale KV for first-run. we'll add to post-cutover checklist.
priya: uploading proxy config snippet to the customer bucket now. link: https://files.redwood/priv/acme/proxy-sample.txt
alex_r: checksum verified at 9:12 PT on my end. All set from staging.
ben-oncall: prober results: 200 from mirror, no TLS alerts. I'll post full logs to incidents channel and update here.
maya.k: great — milestone: network sweep complete and CR merged. I'll close this thread after post-cutover validation summary.
